title: 第十九章 青木火莲到手丹祖炉现第二十章 黑炉封路丹祖炉不能不开
slug: 天赋每周一刷新从变废为宝开始成仙
content_zh:
徐少阳听不懂周荒的话。
但他很不喜欢周荒脸上的笑。
一个刚入外门的杂役，凭什么面对他还能笑得出来？
“动手。”
徐少阳懒得再废话。
三名合欢堂弟子同时冲出。
沈青禾想要上前，却被徐少阳一道剑气拦住。
“沈师妹，炼丹堂最好别管合欢堂的私事。”
顾清寒拔剑，冷声道：
“秘境内同门不得无故相残。”
徐少阳笑了。
“顾师姐看清楚，是周荒贪图青木火莲，引动古殿禁制，死于非命。与我何干？”
话音落下，他袖中飞出数枚血色阵旗，瞬间钉在古殿四周。
黑气翻涌。
周荒眼中的凶光猛地暴涨。
原来如此。
徐少阳不是单纯要杀他，而是想借古殿残阵，把这里所有不听话的人一起埋了。
青丹殿大门震动，一缕缕黑烟从门缝涌出，隐约传来低沉嘶吼。
沈青禾脸色大变。
“血引阵！殿里有东西！”

徐少阳大笑。
“不错。黑炉的人告诉我，青丹殿下压着一具古修尸傀。只要以活人气血引动，它便会醒。周荒，你不是很能打吗？那就陪它玩玩。”
三名合欢堂弟子杀到近前。
周荒没有硬拼，反而一步踏向殿门右侧。
在趋吉避凶视野中，那里黑气最浓，却有一缕细得几乎看不见的白光。
死中藏生。
他相信系统。
“拦住他！”
徐少阳脸色一变。
可已经晚了。
周荒一剑斩在右侧石狮口中。
咔嚓。
石狮崩开，露出一枚暗淡阵珠。
青木离火剑刺入阵珠，青红灵焰轰然灌入。
血引阵猛地一滞。
可刹那间，周荒脸色也变了。
那缕白光并不是完整生门。
只是半条活路。
阵珠碎裂后，黑气没有立刻反卷徐少阳，反而像一张巨网，瞬间锁住青木火莲附近所有活人。
沈青禾闷哼一声，腕上浮现血线。

顾清寒也后退半步，剑锋轻颤。
徐少阳大笑。
“真以为我不知道那里是阵眼？周荒，那是我故意留给你的！”
周荒心头一沉。
这徐少阳不是送宝的蠢货。
content_en:
Xu Shaoyang couldn't understand Zhou Huang's words.
But he didn't like the smile on Zhou Huang's face.
How could a handyman who had just entered the outer sect smile in front of him?
"Do it."
Xu Shaoyang was too lazy to talk nonsense.
Three Hehuan Hall disciples rushed out at the same time.
Shen Qinghe wanted to step forward, but was stopped by Xu Shaoyang's sword energy.
"Junior Sister Shen, it's best for the Alchemy Hall to stay out of Hehuan Hall's private affairs."
Gu Qinghan drew his sword and said coldly:
"Same sects within the secret realm must not kill each other for no reason."
Xu Shaoyang smiled.
"Senior Sister Gu has seen clearly that it was Zhou Huang who coveted the Green Wood Fire Lotus, triggered the ban on the ancient palace, and died unexpectedly. What does it have to do with me?"
As soon as he finished speaking, several bloody formation flags flew out of his sleeves and were instantly nailed around the ancient palace.
Black air surged.
The ferocious light in Zhou Huang's eyes suddenly surged.
I see.
Xu Shaoyang didn't just want to kill him, but wanted to use the remaining formation of the ancient palace to bury all the disobedient people here.
The door of Qingdan Palace shook, wisps of black smoke poured out from the cracks in the door, and a low roar could be faintly heard.
Shen Qinghe's expression changed drastically.
"Blood-induced formation! There is something in the palace!"
Xu Shaoyang laughed.
"That's right. The people from Black Furnace told me that His Highness Qingdan is holding an ancient corpse puppet. As long as it is activated with the blood of a living person, it will wake up. Zhou Huang, aren't you very good at fighting? Then play with it."
Three Hehuan Hall disciples came closer.
Zhou Huang did not fight hard, but stepped towards the right side of the palace gate.
In the field of vision of seeking good luck and avoiding evil, where the black air is the thickest, there is a wisp of white light that is so thin that it is almost invisible.
Death hides life.
He believes in the system.
"Stop him!"
Xu Shaoyang's expression changed.
But it's too late.
Zhou Huang struck the right stone lion in the mouth with his sword.
Click.
The stone lion collapsed, revealing a dim array bead.
The Qingmu Lihuo Sword pierced the formation bead, and the green and red spiritual flames burst into it.
The blood formation suddenly stagnated.
But in an instant, Zhou Huang's expression also changed.
That ray of white light is not a complete birth gate.
It's only half a way to survive.
After the formation bead shattered, the black energy did not immediately roll back into Xu Shaoyang. Instead, it was like a giant net, instantly locking all living people near the Green Wood Fire Lotus.
Shen Qinghe groaned, and blood lines appeared on his wrists.
Gu Qinghan also took half a step back, the edge of his sword trembling slightly.
Xu Shaoyang laughed.
"You really think I don't know where the formation eye is? Zhou Huang, I left that for you on purpose!"
Zhou Huang's heart sank.
This Xu Shaoyang is not a fool who gives away treasures.
